name: pagespeed-quest
description: Adds /psq-usage, /psq-install, /psq-record, /psq-measure, /psq-inventory and /psq-video skills for investigating a page's loading speed: freeze any web page into an editable local recording, replay it with the original timing, try changes one at a time, and report what each measurably gained with Lighthouse, video and visual diffs.
